profiles.stockfish: upstream built-in fixed-depth bench; bind benchmark.cpp, source revision, executable, NNUE, options and actual variable node workload
profiles.cutechess: paired-color Stockfish self-play from the standard initial position, ponder disabled and explicit fixed game depth/time control, with no default move cap; independent locked provider legally replays every PGN and requires a matching normal terminal outcome
profiles.capped_diagnostic: explicit --diagnostic with --max-moves only; maximum-length episodes retain diagnostic episode and ply rates, never normal-game capacity recommendations

resources.cpu: minimum of caller affinity and every visible ancestor CPU quota; preserve fractional CPU equivalence
resources.memory: minimum of MemAvailable and every visible ancestor memory.max minus memory.current
resources.game_cpu: concurrency times threads per active engine with ponder off
resources.game_memory: two resident engines per game times Hash plus explicit overhead estimate; enforce sampled RSS ceiling
resources.hidden_ancestors: unobservable; never claim whole physical host capacity
resources.time: explicit finite per-case and whole-experiment wall budgets; timeout or incomplete games fail without a recommendation

receipts: exact external legal-PGN validator archive, runtime bytes and license
normal terminal outcome and complete legal move count for every credited full game
database recording and readback measured separately; absent from this external-tool calibration
recommendation: only best measured configuration for this input, execution environment and resource grant; elapsed-workload and aggregate-game throughput remain separate
forbidden_claims: fixed-depth SMP does identical node work
compiled huge-page support proves actual allocation
tool availability proves Laplace chess or Lichess service capability
move-capped adjudicated episodes prove full-game capacity
external engine generation rate proves database-recorded game throughput

deployment_calibration.authorization: User-requested complete chess dependency setup and measured configuration on the actual deployment host. This chess-only calibration does not change unrelated benchmark-suite scheduling.
deployment_calibration.gate: accepted main deployment succeeded and exact change selection contains a chess dependency or calibration implementation change

candidate_calibration.authorization: Same-repository pull requests with selected chess dependency or calibration changes may run source dependency builds and machine calibration after hosted proof. Calibration verifies and builds its own official source inputs under the shared host lock.
candidate_calibration.gate: same-repository pull request with exact chess change selection and successful hosted proof; independent of PostgreSQL custom-stack proof, which remains separately required by product-path
candidate_calibration.evidence_scope: candidate dependency measurements, separate from deployed product activation and core benchmark scheduling
candidate_calibration.acceptance: selected candidate calibration must succeed before product-path and its protected check aliases can pass
